policy: Forge fetches each SDK by full commit SHA into the private sdk-vault on explicit approval. Public Forge releases contain no SDK source or binaries, and an existing vault directory that is not the pinned commit is never overwritten. Move a pin only after reading the upstream diff and rebuilding a real plugin; a ref name is a label, the commit is the contract.

sdks.role: CommonLibSSE-NG (alandtse ng lineage): C++23 SKSE plugin library for SE, AE and VR from one DLL. Read include/RE, include/REL and include/SKSE for exact API; consume with CMake add_subdirectory or xmake.
sdks.license: GPL-3.0-or-later with Modding Exception and Linking Exception (COPYING.txt, EXCEPTIONS.md)

sdks.role: vcpkg package manager used by native-build and by the CommonLibSSE-NG dependency manifest. Needs --bootstrap once to produce vcpkg.exe, then pin it with tool-configure vcpkg.
libxse/commonlibsse main: Xmake 3.0+ CommonLibSSE lineage. Reference for plugins that declare it; do not mix its idioms (REX::INFO logging) into a CommonLibSSE-NG plugin.
sdks.license: GPL-3.0-or-later with Modding Exception and Linking Exception (LICENSE, EXCEPTIONS)

sdks.role: powerof3/CommonLibSSE dev: SE/AE-only CMake lineage behind many established plugins (KID, SPID, PapyrusExtender family). Needed to rebuild or rework a plugin that pins it.
sdks.license: GPL-3.0-or-later with Modding Exception and Linking Exception (COPYING.txt, EXCEPTIONS.md)

sdks.role: libxse commonlibsse-ng-template: minimal xmake SKSE plugin template that submodules the alandtse ng lineage; a real consumer layout to copy from.
